name: wild-kart
description: Wild Kart : jeu de kart pour soirées entre potes.

scripts.preparer: npx cap add android && npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-native.cjs && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --ios --iconBackgroundColor "#17143a" --iconBackgroundColorDark "#17143a" --splashBackgroundColor "#17143a" --splashBackgroundColorDark "#17143a" && npx cap sync
scripts.preparer-android: npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-native.cjs && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor "#17143a" --splashBackgroundColor "#17143a" && npx cap sync android
scripts.preparer-ios: npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-native.cjs && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor "#17143a" --splashBackgroundColor "#17143a" && npx cap sync ios
